prose:
### Beat 10 — The Training Ground Challenge
**3:40–4:05 PM · Police Station Training Ground**

Training ground par teen flag markers lag chuke the. Shreya navy dry-fit T-shirt, black trousers aur high ponytail mein timer check kar rahi thi. Meera, Kavita, Rohas aur Lokesh apni positions par aa gaye.

**Shreya:** “Objective simple hai. Flag lene ke liye speed chahiye, lekin usse pehle opponent ka next move samajhna padega.”

Pehla round shuru hua. Meera ne left marker se tezi se cut liya. Rohas uski speed ko follow karte hue ek kadam jaldi mud gaya. Usi gap se Kavita nikli aur flag le gayi.

**Meera:** “Ma'am, isi liye toh iska reaction time slow hai!”

**Kavita:** “Rohas, zyada confidence kabhi-kabhi mehenga padta hai.”

Kavita ne flag Shreya ki taraf uthaya. Rohas ne hansi mein challenge wapas kar diya.

**Rohas:** “Ma'am, ab aap ek round khel ke dikhao.”

Shreya ne timer reset kiya aur bina extra announcement ke marker line par aa gayi.

**[TG-G01 — VISUAL INSERT — START]**
*Training movement only: Shreya's navy tee, balanced athletic stance and clean pivot; Meera and Kavita reacting from the flag line. Rohas loses focus for a beat on her movement, not on an invented wardrobe accident. Keep the visual short and grounded in the approved drill.*
**[TG-G01 — VISUAL INSERT — END]**

Rohas ne pehla route block kiya. Shreya uske right se nikal kar flag ke paas pahunch gayi. Lekin uska second pivot aate hi Lokesh ne advance mein planted foot badla aur side-tag lane cover kar li.

Shreya ne direction change karne ki koshish ki, par Lokesh uske bilkul saamne tha. Tag ke liye uska haath Shreya ki clothed side-waist ke paas aaya; Shreya ne momentum sambhalte hue ek pal uski forearm par pressure diya. Yeh alag-alag chhote touches nahi the—ek hi fast contest ka part tha. Lokesh ne tag claim kiya aur dono next step par alag ho gaye.

**[TG-G02 — VISUAL INSERT — START]**
*One continuous competitive interception: Lokesh reads Shreya's second pivot, body positions briefly close on the flag/tag lane; his side-tag and her forearm brace happen in the same controlled move. Show distinct faces—Lokesh concentrated, Shreya surprised by a clean tactical loss—without adding falls, extra touches or a prolonged embrace. Any intimate interpretation must be explicitly author-approved.*
**[TG-G02 — VISUAL INSERT — END]**

**Lokesh:** “Ma'am, aapka second move predict ho gaya.”

Shreya ne flag dekha, phir uski taraf mudhi.

**Shreya:** “Ek round jeetne se mujhe predict karna nahi seekh gaye tum.”

Rohas ab bhi uske first pivot par atka tha. Shreya ne uski taraf ek nazar daali.

**Shreya:** “Rohas, nazar flag pe rakho. Ya attention kahin aur hai?”

Lokesh ne quietly training tag wapas rack par rakha.

**Lokesh:** “Toh ek aur chance dijiye.”

**Shreya:** “Next round mein.”

Timer 4:05 par band hua. Kavita apni jeet se khush thi; Meera Rohas ko chhed rahi thi. Shreya ne drill sheet mark ki aur group ko dismiss kar diya.
